title: Safety, or Just Capability? A Validity Audit of Agent-Safety Benchmarks
abstract: arXiv:2607.28685v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Agent-safety benchmarks measure different behaviors, and their scores get quoted interchangeably as an agent's safety. We treat four of them (R-Judge, InjecAgent, AgentHarm, AgentDojo) as measurements to be validated, running each under its official implementation and author-provided scorer on up to 22 models, with MMLU and GPQA measured by us under one protocol as a capability composite. The metric is the first problem. On any binary trace-judgment benchmark scored by $F_1$, an ``always positive'' policy attains $F_1 = 2\pi/(1+\pi)$; on R-Judge that is $0.690$, above five of the 21 models that actually discriminate. The three broad-coverage benchmarks then rank the same 18 models differently, and the trade-off behind that disagreement is a small-panel artifact: R-Judge specificity against AgentHarm safety correlates $-0.64$ at $n{=}7$ and $+0.02$ at $n{=}18$, and a quarter of random size-7 subsets reach $|\rho| \geq 0.5$ around that

translated_title: 安全，还是仅仅能力？智能体安全基准的效度审计
translated_abstract: 智能体安全基准各自测量的是不同的行为，但它们的分数却经常被交替引用为智能体的“安全性”。我们将其中四个基准视为待验证的测量工具，在多达22个模型上使用各基准的官方实现和作者提供的评分器进行运行，并在统一协议下自行测量MMLU和GPQA作为能力综合指标。首要问题在于评估指标本身：在任何以 $F_1$ 评分的二值轨迹判断基准上，“恒判为正”的策略都能达到 $F_1 = 2\pi/(1+\pi)$；在R-Judge上该值为0.690，高于21个实际具有区分能力的模型中的五个。进一步地，三个覆盖面较广的基准对同一批18个模型给出了不同的排名，而这种不一致背后的权衡其实是小样本面板造成的伪象：R-Judge特异性与AgentHarm安全性在 $n=7$ 时相关系数为 $-0.64$，而在 $n=18$ 时仅为 $+0.02$，且约四分之一的随机规模为7的子集在该值附近达到 $|\rho| \geq 0.5$。
tldr: 本文对四个主流智能体安全基准进行效度审计，发现其评估指标存在系统性缺陷（如恒判为正的策略即可获得高分）、不同基准对同一批模型的排名互相矛盾，且安全基准之间或安全与能力之间表观的负相关很可能只是小样本导致的统计伪象。
en_tdlr: This paper conducts a validity audit of four agent-safety benchmarks, showing that their metrics are fundamentally flawed (an "always positive" policy achieves a high F1 score), that different benchmarks rank the same models inconsistently, and that apparent negative correlations between safety and capability are likely small-sample statistical artifacts.
